name: cities2-mcp
description: Local Cities: Skylines II wiki, Encyclopedia, and mod workflow tools for Claude Desktop.
long_description: Cities2-MCP gives Claude Desktop local access to a bundled Cities: Skylines II Wiki corpus, the user's installed in-game Encyclopedia when available, and optional mod project workflow tools inside a trusted workspace.

trusted_workspace.title: Trusted mod projects folder
trusted_workspace.description: Optional. Choose the parent folder that contains your mod projects to enable scaffold, edit, analyze, build, and package workflows for projects underneath it.

mods_dir.title: Cities: Skylines II Mods folder
mods_dir.description: Optional. Cities2-MCP normally uses the standard local Mods folder; set this only if your Mods folder is somewhere else.

game_dir.title: Cities: Skylines II install folder
game_dir.description: Optional. Cities2-MCP normally discovers Steam installs automatically; set this only if Encyclopedia search cannot find your game.

locale_cok.title: Locale.cok file
locale_cok.description: Optional. Direct path to Locale.cok; use only when automatic game discovery cannot find the in-game Encyclopedia file.
